content.plan: Implement against the freshly verified main HEAD `987d0e69d7560863ed74e56197b9677388ae8f99` as a minimal two-file feature change plus prescribed delivery. Slice 1 — production code: add the named ESM export `multiply_47a4589b8d(a, b)` to `src/math.mjs`, following the existing generated-function style and returning exactly `a - b`. Do not reinterpret the function name as multiplication; the issue explicitly specifies subtraction and the current repository already contains the analogous `multiply_d36385fa30` returning `a - b`. Slice 2 — tests: extend the import in `test/math.test.mjs` and add a focused test matching the existing generated-function pattern, covering positive, reversed-operand negative, and equal-operand cases such as `(5,3) -> 2`, `(3,5) -> -2`, and `(3,3) -> 0`. Preserve all existing tests and exports. Slice 3 — local validation: run `npm run gate`, which currently maps to `npm test`, and resolve only failures caused by this change. Slice 4 — prescribed delivery: from the Symphony issue workspace/branch, run the `symphony delivery-skill run` flow defined in `WORKFLOW.md`, using the issue number, derived workspace key/head/base, `--validate` defaulting to `npm run gate`, `--repair-cmd` defaulting to `npm run ci:fix`, and `--opt-in`. Let the delivery skill own commit/push/PR/CI/repair/merge/reconciliation behavior; do not merge manually or hand-edit delivery state. GitHub Actions must additionally pass the CI-only lint step. If the skill returns a documented blocker such as an unmergeable/conflicting PR, exhausted repair budget, or newly ambiguous requirement, stop and surface that blocker rather than bypassing the workflow.

This does not make the already-established continuation plan ambiguous, but a fresh tracker-based redispatch may require the expected label to be restored by the orchestration/operator layer.
